items.title: Morgan Stanley Sinks 6%, Goldman Down 6%, Citi Down 5% as Market Selloff Drags Wall Street Banks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMorgan Stanley fell 6% today, with Goldman Sachs and Citigroup down about as much, in a broad selloff with no company news behind it. Morgan Stanley leans on trading far more than JPMorgan Chase, which leaves it among the banks most exposed if trading and dealmaking cool.

items.title: Morgan Stanley cuts Cisco rating, sees pull-forward risk after strong run
items.summary: Investing.com -- Morgan Stanley downgraded Cisco Systems (NASDAQ:CSCO) to Equal-weight from Overweight and cut its price target to $120 from $135 in a note Thursday, telling investors that the stock’s strong rally leaves less room for upside ahead of its fiscal first-quarter results.
